$comment: External liveness watchdog thresholds (scripts/argusWatchdog.ts + scripts/lib/argusWatchdogLogic.ts). Per AGENTS.md hard rule: operational/safety thresholds live here, not as TypeScript literals; the logic module's DEFAULT_WATCHDOG_CONFIG is derived from this file, and env vars (ARGUS_WATCHDOG_*) override at runtime. Missing keys fail watchdog startup (enforced by loadWatchdogConfig in scripts/lib/argusWatchdogLogic.ts, mirroring the runtimeIntervals 'missing keys fail boot' pattern) - a watchdog with unknown thresholds must not guess. 2026-10-08 I-W3: the dead pollMs key was REMOVED from this file - nothing ever read it from here; the poll cadence comes only from the ARGUS_WATCHDOG_POLL_MS env var (scripts/argusWatchdog.ts), so keeping the key here was a lie about what controls the loop.
_maintenanceComment: 2026-10-08 defect #3 hardening: the watchdog previously treated ANY stale heartbeat + unresponsive /ready + live PID as a genuinely frozen process after frozenConfirmTicks. Known event-loop-blocking maintenance (DB backup, heap snapshot, graceful drain) produces exactly the same observable signature, and the watchdog force-killed the engine mid-maintenance - each kill restarted the same maintenance and re-blocked, a restart storm. Maintenance signals are consulted first; judgment is deferred (never escalated) while a FRESH maintenance signal is active, up to maintenanceDeferralMaxMs. A signal older than maintenanceFreshnessMs is untrusted (publisher may be dead) and ignored - deferral never outlives provably-live maintenance.
_restartDisciplineComment: Cooldown + exponential backoff between restarts: delay = min(restartCooldownBaseMs * 2^restartsInWindow, restartCooldownMaxMs). Exceeding maxRestarts in the window is a STORM LOCKOUT - persisted to data/.argus_watchdog_state.json so it survives watchdog restarts, and only liftable by an explicit operator action (argus watchdog-clear-lockout).
_startupGraceComment: After a (re)start the engine needs ~65-75s before /ready answers and the heartbeat interval fires; a stale heartbeat with a live PID in that window is boot, not a freeze. Escalation is deferred (counters frozen, never reset) until startupGraceMs after the session file's startedAt.
